terminalContract: VERSION, SPEC.md, CHANGELOG.md, docs/references/verification-report.md, and docs/governance/development-tags.md agree on one v1.1.1 verification/test/CI/release-architecture candidate. Release notes disclose that firmware, UI, support, composition bytes, output naming, and Version deployment are unchanged; that v1.1.1 returns to the ordinary protected Windows release package without performing Catalog or Registry deployment; and that the protected workflow, exact package/assets, smoke, immutable tag/Release, and fresh-download audit remain publication gates. The exact final identity head must receive structure/render validation, exact-head CI, reviewed-tree equivalence, renewed existing package-source authority, protected release-owner approval, and post-publication evidence before closure.

designReview.evidence: The owner approved the verification-only v1.1.1 scope, instructed that v1.0.8 remain frozen and Version deployment remain disabled, authorized direct publication when residual risk is low, and approved the balanced later-version TODO allocation. The missing synchronized v1.1.1 identity is therefore closed through the established owner rather than by changing product scope or inventing a release path.
